name: ERBB receptor feedback inhibitor 1
pathways: negative regulation of epidermal growth factor-activated receptor activity

function.text: ERRFI1 encodes ERBB receptor feedback inhibitor 1. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activator activity and SH3 domain binding. It participates in negative regulation of epidermal growth factor-activated receptor activity and skin morphogenesis.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
